summary: F7 security review for PR #5: reviewed VCS pipeline protections and promotion workflows; 3 actionable findings, highest severity BLOCKER.

findings.issue: The dev protection record sets required_approving_reviews to 0 and comments out the oya-pr-review required check. The agentic VCS pipeline can therefore admit security-sensitive changes without an enforced reviewer-agent gate.
findings.remediation: Restore a required review gate before treating the pipeline as end-to-end: require either approving reviews or an oya-pr-review check that fails closed when the multispectrum panel is incomplete or pending.

findings.issue: Both promotion workflows document that canary/full-rollout observability gates are FUTURE and currently always promote. This is fail-open promotion from dev to staging and staging to production.
findings.remediation: Add mandatory canary and full-rollout health gates before advancing refs, or disable automatic promotion until those gates exist and fail closed on missing/unknown observability evidence.

findings.issue: The downstream production promotion path optionally uses a broad WORKFLOW_PAT secret to trigger another workflow, with no environment approval or scoped app-token boundary documented in the workflow.
findings.remediation: Replace the PAT path with a least-privilege GitHub App or environment-protected deployment token, and require explicit environment gates for staging/production promotion.
